description: A production pixel art grass ground texture atlas for a cozy orthogonal farming RPG. EXACTLY 64x32 pixels, 4 columns and 2 rows of 16x16 seamless square tiles, no gaps, no grid lines, no border, no text. Eight subtle variations of the SAME medium muted green lawn. Main base color approximately #43894f, shadows #3b7e4a, light leaf strokes #509458, all close in brightness. Keep 85-95 percent of each tile plain base green, only a few tiny 2-3 pixel leaf strokes, sparse compact clusters off center. Two tiles almost plain, two with one tiny cluster, two with a few low-contrast flecks, two with small corner clusters. Tile edges share the same base color so any tile connects to any other. Flat top-down ground, no elevation or outlines. Calm walkable meadow under trees and buildings. No dark grass islands, no pale yellow-green, no centered repeating tufts, no long diagonal rows, no checkerboard, no flowers, no bushes, no objects, no ground shadow, no dithering, no gradients, no blur. Deliberate crisp native pixel art. The atlas must read as one quiet green field with restrained scattered leaf marks.
